name: TV Sorter
description: Creates a Jellyfin-compatible TV library from an unsorted media directory using symbolic links without modifying the original media.
overview: Organize unsorted TV media for Jellyfin using symbolic links.

versions.changelog:
- Added unattended TVmaze show-name canonicalization with persistent caching.
- Normalized trailing years and case variants with local fallback when online matching fails.
- Safely reconciled old managed links into canonical show directories.
